title: psychotria decumbens
intro: Psychotria decumbens, commonly known as the "Brazilian Wrinkle Relaxer", is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing wrinkles and fine lines, improving skin elasticity, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria decumbens include its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and promote collagen production, making it a popular ingredient in skincare products. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its anti-aging and antioxidant effects.
